## Part 1: Data Processing

```{r}
# 1) Use httr::GET to return topic information 
# using SEPT 01, 2026 as date due to 30 day Free trail restriction

url <- "https://api.census.gov/data/2024/acs/acs1/pums?get=SEX,PWGTP,MAR&for=state:*&SCHL=24&key=2aa23f6929b5b51bb7e24e90cc25a4c02d9290ca"

data <- httr::GET(url)
str(news_data, max.level = 1)

# 2) Parse returned information for the actual article information
content(data)
data_parsed <- fromJSON(rawToChar(data$content))

# Store & print actual article information
articles_df <- as_tibble(data_parsed$articles)
articles_df
```
